meta.title: 侧栏布局大师 · Sidebar Suite
meta.description: 一款专门针对改进 DSH 左侧栏体验的插件：三种布局一键切换、会话默认全展开、临时会话用完即删、设置与反馈都在本页，强实用性；界面沿用宿主原生配色、圆角与间距，只加属性不重构宿主结构，克制又好看。｜A plugin dedicated to a better DSH sidebar: one-click layouts, always-expanded sessions, disposable temp sessions and in-page settings/feedback — seriously practical; native colours, radii and spacing with zero host-DOM rewrites — restrained and good-looking.
